subject: Re: BYOK ceremony details, operator eviction playbook & evidence timeline
messages:
From: David Barnes <dbarnes@finrise.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, security@finrise.com
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: BYOK/HSM evidence needed for SIG+CAIQ review

Hi Karthik / Redwood security team,

Thanks for the call earlier — FinRise's auditors asked for a compact package we can include in our SIG/CAIQ intake for the upcoming vendor review. To keep this tight, can you please provide the following artifacts and a short narrative for each item by EOD 2027-04-25? Our priority items are:

- HSM ceremony minutes (signed attendees, time/date, vendor attestation)
- Operator separation & shift log excerpts for the last 90 days (redacted operator IDs acceptable)
- KEK wrap/unwrap sample (hex/trace of a single wrap operation) and the associated algorithm/crypto params
- KMS audit trail extract showing key rotation events for the tenant's KEK in question (last 12 months)
- TLS cipher inventory for endpoints that serve tenant key material in transit

We may accept redacted logs if vendor policy forbids full exports; please note any restrictions. Also include any short runbook that describes your emergency key-eviction procedure (who signs off, steps, expected RTO).

If there's a preferred secure delivery mechanism (SFTP link, signed Drive folder, or DocuSign for ceremony minutes) let us know. This will feed into our CAIQ answers and the SIG auditor packet.

Regards,
David Barnes
Security Engineering Lead, FinRise
security@finrise.com

-----

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: David Barnes <dbarnes@finrise.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 10:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BYOK/HSM evidence needed for SIG+CAIQ review

Hi David — thanks for the clear checklist. We can assemble this. High-level notes up front:

- We can provide signed HSM ceremony minutes (PDF) and a compact KEK wrap sample.
- Raw operator shift logs are subject to vendor / privacy considerations; we can provide redacted CSV excerpts and an operator separation attest signed by our SOC2 compliance contact.
- KMS rotation audit events: we can export a time-bound JSON/CSV of rotation events; if you need a specific format, confirm.
- TLS cipher inventory: we'll include our endpoint inventory and cipher suites used for key transport.
- Emergency key-eviction runbook: we'll provide a one-page runbook and escalation tree.

Plan / next steps:
1) Internal owners looped — Laura will own HSM ceremony minutes and vendor attestation, Ben will compile KMS rotation exports and wrap sample, Marissa will prepare shift log excerpts and the runbook.
2) We'll prepare a secure Drive folder and share a link with FinRise security; if you need SFTP, we can arrange.
3) Target to deliver the initial packet (redacted logs + minutes + wrap sample + runbook) by 2027-04-22, then follow up with any additional extracts by 2027-04-25.

If that timeline works, we'll proceed and flag any vendor constraints early.

Subject: Re: BYOK/HSM evidence needed for SIG+CAIQ review — owners & ETA

Agree with Karthik's plan. I ran a quick vendor check (HSM provider) and confirmed: we can provide ceremony minutes and an attestation letter; full operator PII must be redacted. Delivery plan below: 

- HSM ceremony minutes & vendor attestation: Laura (owner) — deliver PDF by 2027-04-20.
- Operator shift log excerpts (redacted CSV): Marissa (owner) — deliver sample CSV with 7-10 rows demonstrating shift handover and operator separation by 2027-04-22.
- KEK wrap/unwrap sample + crypto params: Ben (owner) — provide a one-page trace (hex snippet) and alg specs by 2027-04-20. Note: wrap operation will be a sanitized trace (no plaintext keys).
- KMS rotation event export (timestamp, event_type, actor, key_id, event_meta): Ben — provide CSV/JSON extract for last 12 months by 2027-04-22.
- TLS cipher inventory: I'll pull endpoint inventory and list TLS versions / ciphers used for key-transport endpoints by 2027-04-20.
- Emergency key-eviction runbook (one page + RACI): Marissa — draft by 2027-04-20.

I'll create a shared Drive folder with restricted access for FinRise security and drop the initial packet into a subfolder called "DF-7892 - SIG packet (redacted)". I'll add a README summarizing any vendor constraints. If FinRise wants DocuSign for ceremony minutes, we can sign and upload a PDF.

Laura Bennett
Sr. Compliance Program Manager, Redwood Inference

From: David Barnes <dbarnes@finrise.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: security@finrise.com
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 10:11:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BYOK/HSM evidence needed for SIG+CAIQ review — owners & ETA

Laura / Karthik — this is great, thanks. A few clarifications before you finalize: 

- For operator logs: redacted CSV is fine. Please include a mapping document that explains which fields were redacted and why.
- For the KEK wrap sample: we only need a non-sensitive trace (no keys) and a short note of the wrapping algorithm (e.g., RSA-OAEP-AES-GCM, key lengths).
- For KMS rotation events: include any automation identifiers (e.g., rotation job ids) and, if possible, the trigger source (manual vs scheduled). The auditor cares about change triggers.
- Ceremony minutes: if you can provide a DocuSign-signed PDF, that would speed review. If vendor policy prevents signing, an attestation PDF signed by Redwood's Compliance lead is acceptable.

Delivery to Drive link is perfect. Once you upload, email me the link and I'll circulate to our auditor. If anything changes on your ETA please flag immediately — our review window opens 2027-04-26.

Thanks,
David

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com

David — thanks for the clarifications. We're on track; summary and links below.

What we uploaded (Drive folder: DF-7892 - SIG packet (redacted)):

- operator_shift_log_excerpt.csv (stub) — 10-line redacted sample + mapping.txt that explains redaction rationale.
- kek-wrap-sample.txt (stub) — sanitized wrap trace + algorithm notes (AES-KW + RSA-OAEP metadata).
- kms_rotation_events.csv (stub) — rotation timestamps, actor (system/manual), key_id, event_note.
- tls_cipher_inventory.txt (stub) — endpoint -> TLS versions and cipher suites used.
- key_eviction_runbook.pdf (stub) — one-page runbook and RACI.

Delivery notes:
- Operator IDs redacted per vendor data-sharing policy; mapping.txt documents fields removed.
- KMS rotation extract includes rotation job ids and a "trigger_source" column (manual / scheduled).
- If the auditor requests raw logs, we will need a formal data-sharing agreement addendum from FinRise to proceed; we flagged that in README.

Drive link: https://drive.redwood.com/FinRise/DF-7892/ceremony-minutes (access granted to security@finrise.com).

If you need any supplementary format (e.g., SFTP push or encrypted S3 object), tell us and we'll schedule the transfer.

Thanks — I'll keep the thread open for follow-ups.
